Package org.bsc.langgraph4j

Class GraphResult

java.lang.Object
org.bsc.langgraph4j.GraphResult
public final class GraphResult extends Object
Represents the unified result of a graph execution.

This class encapsulates different types of results that can be produced by a graph, such as interruption metadata, node output, checkpoint tags, or raw state data. It provides methods to check the type of the result and retrieve it safely.

    • from

      public static GraphResult from(Object result)
      Creates a GraphResult from the object returning by the AsyncGenerator obtained by StateGraph.stream() call.

      The method attempts to determine the type of the result and wrap it in a GraphResult. Supported types are:

      • GraphResult (returns the object itself)
      • Map (treated as state data)
      • NodeOutput
      • InterruptionMetadata
      • BaseCheckpointSaver.Tag
      If the input is null, an empty GraphResult is returned.

      Parameters:
      result - the object to wrap.
      Returns:
      a GraphResult instance.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the result type is not supported.

    • asStateData

      public Map<String,Object> asStateData()
      Retrieves the result as a map of state data, filtered by the graph's output schema.

      If the result is a checkpoint saver tag, the state of its last checkpoint is returned instead, so callers can treat both result kinds uniformly.

      Returns:
      the state data map, restricted to the keys allowed by the output schema.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the result is neither state data nor a checkpoint saver tag, or if the tag does not contain any checkpoint.
      See Also:
      • asLastCheckpointStateData()

    • asState

      public <S extends AgentState> S asState()
      Retrieves the result as a typed agent state, built from asStateData() through the graph's state factory.

      Only results created through the graph (see from(Object, StateGraph)) carry a state factory; instances created with from(Object) or empty() cannot be converted.

      Type Parameters:
      S - the expected agent state type; the cast is unchecked, so a mismatch surfaces as a ClassCastException at the call site.
      Returns:
      a new state instance populated with the (schema-filtered) state data.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no state factory is available, if the result is neither state data nor a checkpoint saver tag, or if the tag does not contain any checkpoint.
      See Also:
      • asStateData()

    • asStateDataOrLastCheckpointStateData

      @Deprecated(since="1.9.8", forRemoval=true) public Map<String,Object> asStateDataOrLastCheckpointStateData()
      Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
      Use asStateData() instead for clarity.
      Retrieves the state data regardless of whether the result holds it directly or through a checkpoint saver tag.

      If the result is state data, it is returned filtered by the output schema; otherwise the state of the last checkpoint of the tag is returned.

      Returns:
      the state data map.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the result is neither state data nor a checkpoint saver tag, or if the tag does not contain any checkpoint.
      See Also:
      • isStateDataOrCheckpointSaverTag()
